message: Designer is checking the furniture layout

The sofa’s muted sage green fits the room’s earthy palette: beige rug, walnut-brown table, terracotta chair and warm cream walls. However, no room image or floor finish is supplied, so I can’t confirm the sofa–floor match. If the floor is warm wood or neutral beige, sage should complement it well.

One optional small improvement: a slightly warmer cream sofa colour could tie it more closely to the rug—but the sage provides pleasant contrast. Nothing has been changed.
